classification.difficultyReason: Use the marked right angle and alpha to identify each requested side, then read its supplied length; no calculation or method selection is required.

content.prompt: For the triangle opposite, relative to the reference angle $\alpha$, what is the length of:

spec.description: Horizontal upper side, vertical right side and diagonal descending to the right; alpha is inside the upper-left vertex. Source blue becomes black.
spec.mathematics: Legs 8 cm and 6 cm; hypotenuse 10 cm; right angle at upper right.
spec.answerVisibility: All three numerical givens remain visible; side names are responses.

answer.worked: The side opposite the right angle is the hypotenuse, so its length is $10\text{ cm}$.
The side opposite $\alpha$ has length $6\text{ cm}$.
The side next to $\alpha$, excluding the hypotenuse, has length $8\text{ cm}$.
